android.desc:
Joyn offers live TV and a media library in one app. The basic Joyn service is free – simply download and start streaming. With Joyn, you can watch over 100 channels live, including ARD, ZDF, ProSieben, and DMAX.

Live TV is just one part of Joyn. The other major part is our media library. There you'll find tons of shows, exclusive series, and originals like "Promis unter Palmen" (Celebrities Under Palms), "Germany's Next Topmodel," "Wer stiehlt mir die Show" (Who Will Steal My Show?), and "The Race." Plus, previews – full episodes of series before they air on TV.

Watch whenever and wherever you want. And on whatever device you want, because Joyn works on smartphones, tablets, TVs, and in web browsers. If you want to use Joyn's full free service, you need to register (which is also free). Then you'll have access to over 100 channels, tons of shows and series, and many additional features, such as a watchlist and personalized recommendations.

And what is Joyn+?

Joyn+ offers everything Joyn does and more. Joyn+ boasts a huge film library, including titles like Madagascar 1 & 2, Bridget Jones's Diary, Schindler's List, and Shooter, as well as series such as NCIS, Homeland, Detective Conan, and Smallville. Live TV is also significantly expanded with over 100 channels, including four pay-TV channels like ProSieben Fun, Sat.1 Emotions, and wetter.com.

With Joyn+, you experience everything in HD quality (where available). We're constantly expanding our offerings, so you can always look forward to new films, series, and original content.

Love sports?

Welcome to Joyn. Sports fans will find everything they're looking for here: Eurosport, ran, and others regularly broadcast live sporting events like the NBA, Tour de France, DTM, and tennis tournaments. Enjoy 24/7 sports on Joyn. As a user of the free service you can see highlights, with a Joyn+ subscription you get the full sports experience and we are constantly expanding our sports offerings, so stay tuned.
